what: CRITICAL: MemoryStore has two constructor modes — { dbPath } (legacy SQLite-only, used in tests) and { projectRoot } (file-per-memory with JSON files + SQLite cache). All CLI commands and init MUST use { projectRoot } or JSON files are never created, silently breaking the entire file-per-memory architecture. This bug was found by real-world smoke testing after 592 unit tests all passed.
why: Critical bug caught only by smoke testing. 8 files had wrong constructor. Future work on CLI/init code must verify they use { projectRoot }.
